readme:
# BEiT：掩码离散视觉 Token 预测

## 1. 问题

[BEiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.08254) 将掩码图像建模转为离散视觉 token 分类。图像 tokenizer 提供目标 ID；遮挡图像编码器预测移除 patch 对应的 ID。本题从给定 ID 与 patch logits 出发，提取核心预测目标。

实现 `masked_token_cross_entropy(logits, token_ids, mask)`。输入依次是有限 `[B,N,K]` 词表分数、int64 `[B,N]` 目标与 Boolean `[B,N]` mask。`True` 选中一个需要监督的遮挡位置。返回标量平均损失。

## 2. 核心公式

对选中的 patch $(b,n)$，分数 $z_{bnk}$ 预测类别 $y_{bn}$：

$$
p_{bnk}=\frac{\exp z_{bnk}}{\sum_j\exp z_{bnj}},\qquad
\ell_{bn}=\log\sum_k\exp z_{bnk}-z_{bn,y_{bn}}.
$$

令 $M=\sum_{bn}m_{bn}$，损失为

$$
\mathcal L=\begin{cases}\frac1M\sum_{bn:m_{bn}=1}\ell_{bn},&M>0,\\0,&M=0.\end{cases}
$$

使用稳定的 log-sum-exp 或 log-softmax。遮挡位置的 logit 梯度为 $(p_{bnk}-\mathbf1[k=y_{bn}])/M$；可见位置梯度为零。均匀 logits 的损失为 `log(K)`，单类别词表损失为零。

[官方训练代码](https://github.com/microsoft/unilm/blob/master/beit/engine_for_pretraining.py) 在 `no_grad` 下获取 ID，选出遮挡位置标签，再对遮挡 logits 计算均值 `CrossEntropyLoss`。本题额外定义空 mask 的可微零结果，并允许可见目标槽位使用 sentinel。

## 3. 公式到代码

1. 保留输入校验；只有遮挡位置的 ID 必须是合法词表索引。
2. 选择遮挡位置的 logits 行和对应 ID。选择为空时返回与输入 logits 保持连接的标量零。
3. 计算每个标签对应的分数，以及稳定的词表 log partition。
4. 对全部选中 token 的负对数概率求均值。

不要把概率当作 logits 再算交叉熵，不要除以 batch 大小，也不要平均每张图的均值。选中分数与归一化项均须保留梯度。

## 4. 本题约定

- `B,N,K>=1`；logits 为值有限的 float32/float64。ID 为 int64，mask 为 Boolean，设备和 `[B,N]` 轴与 logits 对齐。保持 dtype/device，不修改输入，支持非连续视图。
- 遮挡 ID 位于 `[0,K)`；未选位置 ID 可为任意 sentinel，不能参与 gather。
- mask 标记**需要预测**的位置。可见分数不得影响损失或梯度。
- 空 mask 返回可微标量零，`K=1` 合法。离散 ID 与 mask 不求梯度。
- 每个 patch 的词表分数加独立常数不改变损失；一致的类别重编号、重复数据也不改变均值。

独立测试覆盖标量 log-sum-exp、解析 softmax 梯度及有限差分、不等遮挡数量、sentinel、分数平移、词表反转、空/全 mask 和量级 1000 的 logits。

## 5. 交互图与 CPU 实验

Lab 训练一个有 16 个参数的**共享四分类线性预测头**。12 个合成 one-hot context 向量组成三张图，其中六个位置被遮挡、覆盖四个类别，遮挡数量分别为 `1,3,2`。Adam 使用你的函数，以 `.08` 学习率进行 **100 次真实更新**。独立诊断每十步用 Python 标量重新计算 CE 和遮挡位置准确率。

参考 CPU 的 CE 从 `log(4)≈1.3863` 降到约 `.01292`，准确率达到 `1.0`。T3 要求最终 CE 小于 `.03` 且小于初值的 `.03`、准确率为 `1.0`、提交损失与 oracle 差异小于 `1e-12`。图表展示实际优化与训练集准确率。one-hot context 使该实验成为有界且可学习的目标演示；它不训练 tokenizer、图像编码器或 BEiT 完整预训练系统。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸阅读

对照 BEiT 第 2 节与官方 `engine_for_pretraining.py`。视觉 tokenizer 目标与原始像素有何差异？为什么标签来自未遮挡图像？当 tokenizer 将不同外观 patch 归为同一类别时，学习目标怎样改变？

比较重建像素的 [MAE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.06377)，以及使用中心化教师软目标的 [iBOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07832)。解释 iBOT patch 分支提供的归约为何不同于本题的全局 token 均值。
notes:
# BEiT 实现坑点

官方训练代码在不求梯度时获取视觉 token ID，选择 Boolean mask 指定的位置，再把所选 logits 与 ID 交给普通均值交叉熵。这里的目标是离散硬标签。图像 tokenizer、其训练数据、遮挡图像 Transformer，以及由 token code 重建图像均不在本题范围内。

必须先筛选位置再 gather 标签。可见 sentinel 不代表词表准则内的 `ignore_index`，更不能意外索引到某个类别。空 mask 的零损失属于教学扩展；通常的 BEiT 训练会提供遮挡 token。零值与 `logits.sum()` 相连即可保留全零梯度。

| 错误 | 独立检验证据 |
| --- | --- |
| 监督全部或仅可见 token | 改变可见分数不影响目标，非零梯度只能位于遮挡位置。 |
| 除以 batch 大小 | 不等遮挡数量例有精确的 token 均值标量答案。 |
| 概率当 logits | 标量 log-sum-exp 与 `(p-one_hot)/M` 梯度揭示额外 softmax。 |
| 标签类别错位 | 非均匀分数和不同 ID 锁定每个目标坐标。 |
| detach logits | 损失必须有计算图，遮挡位置导数满足解析公式。 |
| 符号反向 | 均匀分数应得到正的 `log(K)`，真实训练须降低 CE。 |
| 非连续 logits 梯度丢失 | 交错父存储 VJP 保留各选中类别导数，未使用存储梯度为零。 |
| 提前 gather 可见 sentinel | 正负混合越界可见 ID 都必须在 gather 前被忽略。 |

T3 从 12 个确定性 one-hot context 学习 16 个共享分类头参数；六个遮挡位置覆盖四个类别。Adam 以 `.08` 更新 100 次。PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU float64 的 CE 实测为 `1.38629436 → .01292025`，准确率 `1.0`；验收要求 CE 小于 `.03` 且小于初值的 `.03`，并正确分类所有训练标签。公共种子为 42，原生线程上限为二；本实验无随机采样。context 刻意易于分类，以展示提交函数的真实优化，不衡量泛化或 tokenizer 质量。独立数值梯度测试进一步限制仅在训练示例上有效的捷径。

en.title: BEiT Masked Discrete Visual Token Prediction
en.readme:
# BEiT: masked discrete visual-token prediction

## 1. Problem

[BEiT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.08254) turns masked image modeling into classification of discrete visual tokens. An image tokenizer supplies target IDs; a masked image encoder predicts those IDs at removed patch positions. This exercise starts from supplied IDs and patch logits, isolating the prediction objective.

Implement `masked_token_cross_entropy(logits, token_ids, mask)`. Inputs are finite `[B,N,K]` vocabulary scores, int64 `[B,N]` targets and a Boolean `[B,N]` mask. `True` selects a masked position for supervision. Return one scalar mean loss.

## 2. Core equations

For selected patch $(b,n)$, score $z_{bnk}$ predicts target ID $y_{bn}$:

$$
p_{bnk}=\frac{\exp z_{bnk}}{\sum_j\exp z_{bnj}},\qquad
\ell_{bn}=\log\sum_k\exp z_{bnk}-z_{bn,y_{bn}}.
$$

With $M=\sum_{bn}m_{bn}$, the objective is

$$
\mathcal L=\begin{cases}\frac1M\sum_{bn:m_{bn}=1}\ell_{bn},&M>0,\\0,&M=0.\end{cases}
$$

Use a stable log-sum-exp or log-softmax. For a selected position, the logit gradient is $(p_{bnk}-\mathbf1[k=y_{bn}])/M$. Visible positions have zero gradient. Uniform logits give loss `log(K)`; a one-class vocabulary gives zero.

The [official training engine](https://github.com/microsoft/unilm/blob/master/beit/engine_for_pretraining.py) obtains IDs under `no_grad`, selects masked labels, and applies mean `CrossEntropyLoss` to masked logits. Returning differentiable zero for an empty mask and accepting sentinels in visible target slots are explicit exercise extensions.

## 3. From equations to code

1. Keep the supplied validation helpers: only masked IDs must be valid vocabulary indices.
2. Select the masked rows of logits and corresponding IDs. For an empty selection, return a scalar zero connected to the input logits.
3. Compute each selected target's score and stable vocabulary log partition.
4. Average the negative log probabilities over all selected tokens.

Do not feed probabilities into a logits-based cross entropy. Do not divide by batch size or average per-image means. Keep gradients through selected scores and their normalization.

## 4. Exercise conventions

- `B,N,K>=1`; logits have finite float32/float64 values. IDs are int64 and mask is Boolean. Their device and `[B,N]` axes match logits. Preserve dtype/device and inputs; support noncontiguous views.
- Masked IDs are in `[0,K)`. IDs at unselected positions may be arbitrary sentinel values and are never gathered.
- The mask marks positions to **predict**, not positions to ignore. Visible scores do not affect the loss or its gradient.
- Empty mask returns differentiable scalar zero; `K=1` is valid. Discrete IDs and mask do not receive gradients.
- Adding a separate constant to every patch's vocabulary scores preserves the loss. Consistent vocabulary relabeling and duplicated data also preserve it.

Independent tests include scalar log-sum-exp, exact softmax gradients and finite differences, unequal masked counts, sentinels, score shifts, vocabulary reversal, empty/full masks and scores of magnitude 1000.

## 5. Interactive charts and CPU experiment

The Lab trains a **shared four-class linear predictor** with 16 parameters. Twelve synthetic one-hot context vectors form three images; six positions are masked, covering all four labels, with mask counts `1,3,2`. Adam runs **100 actual updates at learning rate `.08`** using your function. The independent diagnostic recomputes CE and masked accuracy from Python scalar scores every ten steps.

Reference CPU CE falls from `log(4)≈1.3863` to about `.01292`, with masked accuracy `1.0`. T3 requires final CE below `.03` and below `.03` of baseline, accuracy `1.0`, and submitted/oracle agreement within `1e-12`. Charts display actual optimization and training-set accuracy. One-hot context makes this a bounded, learnable objective demonstration; it does not train a tokenizer, an image encoder or BEiT's full pretraining system.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further reading

Read BEiT Section 2 and the official `engine_for_pretraining.py`. How do the visual tokenizer's targets differ from raw pixels? Why are target IDs computed from the uncorrupted image? What changes when a tokenizer groups several visually different patches into one class?

Compare [MAE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.06377), which reconstructs pixel values, and [iBOT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.07832), which replaces hard tokenizer labels with centered soft teacher targets. Explain why iBOT's supplied patch-branch reduction differs from this global token mean.
en.notes:
# BEiT implementation notes

The official training engine obtains target visual token IDs without gradients, selects the Boolean masked positions, and passes the selected logits and IDs to ordinary mean cross entropy. Targets are hard discrete IDs here. The image tokenizer, its training data, the masked-image Transformer and reconstruction of an image from tokenizer codes are outside the exercise.

Filtering happens before label gathering. This matters for visible sentinel IDs: they are not an `ignore_index` feature of the vocabulary criterion and must not accidentally index a class. Empty-mask zero is an explicit teaching extension; the normal BEiT training setup supplies masked tokens. A zero linked to `logits.sum()` gives the required all-zero gradient.

| Fault | Independent evidence |
| --- | --- |
| All-token or visible-token supervision | Visible score changes cannot affect the objective; masked gradients alone are nonzero. |
| Dividing by batch size | Unequal mask counts specify a token mean with a closed-form scalar answer. |
| Probabilities treated as logits | Scalar log-sum-exp and analytic `(p-one_hot)/M` gradients reveal the extra softmax. |
| Wrong target class | Nonuniform scores and nonconstant IDs pin each target coordinate. |
| Detached logits | The loss must have a live gradient with exact masked derivatives. |
| Wrong sign | Uniform scores give positive `log(K)`, and real training must improve CE. |
| Strided logit gradient loss | Interleaved parent VJPs preserve every selected class derivative and zero unused storage. |
| Gathering visible sentinel IDs | Mixed negative and positive out-of-range visible IDs must be ignored before gathering. |

T3 trains 16 shared linear-head parameters from twelve deterministic one-hot context vectors, of which six masked positions cover all four labels. Adam performs 100 updates at `.08`. PyTorch 2.14.1 CPU float64 measured CE `1.38629436 → .01292025` and accuracy `1.0`; acceptance is CE below `.03` and below `.03` of baseline, with exact training-label accuracy. The common seed is 42 and native thread cap is two; this experiment uses no random sampling. These context features are deliberately easy to classify and demonstrate optimization of the submitted function, not generalization or tokenizer quality. Numerical gradient checks separately prevent a training-only shortcut from satisfying the module.
